faq.answer: Yes. Every plan has a hostel version built on mess food plus eggs, curd, peanuts and soya.

faq.question: No gym near me?
faq.answer: Pick Master the Bodyweight, or the home version of any plan.

faq.question: Is it for women?
faq.answer: Yes. Same science, with progressions made for women.

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: UPI, card or netbanking through Razorpay. You get a GST invoice.
